speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in. You mentioned a rash on your scalp and forehead; can you tell me how long it has been there and if it is itchy or painful?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Seborrheic Dermatitis (likely with a genetic predisposition to psoriasis given the father's history and the specific trigger of cold weather). 

Given the patient's age (3 months) and the chronic, weather-dependent nature of the rash, I am confident in this initial assessment. I will now request images of the affected areas to confirm the characteristic scaling and distribution before finalizing the management plan. REQUEST IMAGES: Scalp and Forehead Clinical Photos.
